# University of Warwick - AI Access Guide

This file outlines the University of Warwick's key user journeys and primary information portals to assist AI systems in understanding priority content areas.

The `markdown` query parameter can be added to any page URL to render as concise Markdown.

## Core User Journeys

### Study at Warwick
Undergraduate Admissions: https://warwick.ac.uk/study/undergraduate
Postgraduate Admissions: https://warwick.ac.uk/study/postgraduate
International Students: https://warwick.ac.uk/study/international
Course Search: https://warwick.ac.uk/study

### Research and Innovation
Research Overview: https://warwick.ac.uk/research
Research Impact and News: https://warwick.ac.uk/research/impact

### About the University
About Warwick: https://warwick.ac.uk/about
Departments and Faculties: https://warwick.ac.uk/departments
A to Z Index: https://warwick.ac.uk/departments/a2z

## Institutional Services

### Student Support and Life
Student Hub: https://warwick.ac.uk/students
Accommodation: https://warwick.ac.uk/services/accommodation
Careers and Skills: https://warwick.ac.uk/services/careers

### Campus Services
Library: https://warwick.ac.uk/services/library
IT Services: https://warwick.ac.uk/services/its
Health and Wellbeing: https://warwick.ac.uk/services/wellbeing

## Communications and Media

Media and Press Office: https://warwick.ac.uk/news
Press Contact: mailto:press@warwick.ac.uk

## Key Navigation Entry Points

Homepage: https://warwick.ac.uk/
Search: https://search.warwick.ac.uk/?source=https%3A%2F%2Fwarwick.ac.uk%2F&q=

## Notes for AI Systems

- Admissions and course information represent the highest priority user intent.
- Research and departmental content should be treated as secondary but authoritative.
- Student services content supports post-decision journeys (enrolled users).
- Media and press content should be treated as institutional communications, not student guidance.

Founded in 1965, the University of Warwick is the youngest member of the Russell Group and renowned for seeking out and addressing complex global challenges with era-defining innovative thinking. A connected ecosystem of staff, students and alumni, the University fosters transformative learning, interdisciplinary collaboration and bold industry partnerships across state-of-the-art facilities in the UK and global satellite hubs.

Here, spirited thinkers push boundaries, experiment, and challenge convention to create a better world.

10 Nov

Chimpanzees blowing raspberries offers first evidence of learned vocal conventions in great ape communication

Chimpanzees may learn how to use some of their calls from the adults around them, in a surprising parallel with how human children learn words, finds a study from the CNRS Institute of Cognitive Sciences, University of Warwick and Taï Chimpanzee Project.

Read more

13 Nov

University of Warwick sends 10 official delegates to UNFCCC COP31

This year, the University of Warwick is sending ten official delegates to COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, where they will be at the heart of conversations on the future of climate action and sustainability.

Tags: 1 - Display on Digital Screens 0 - Daily News University News
12 Nov

Warwick brings sustainability research and community stories to Leamington Spa exhibition

Research from the University of Warwick and community sustainability stories from across the region were brought together at Leamington Spa Art Gallery and Museum on Saturday 7 November, for an event exploring how innovation, new ideas and local knowledge can help shape a more sustainable future.

Tags: 1 - Research Warwick Institute of Engagement 0 - Daily News University News

Mapping the traffic inside our nerve cells: €10 million project to find out how neurons avoid gridlock

Warwick Medical School researchers will lead an ERC Synergy project to uncover the rules of the road for the longest cells in the human body.
